name: Covenant of the Cave of Twisting Shadows
description: House Criamon covenant haunted by the ghosts of the Criamon Primi, bound to the Axis Magica; its weakest ghosts appear as patches of darkness, giving it its name.

name: Covenant of the Icy North
description: A covenant founded in 771 by magi of different Houses, now a loose affiliation of nine autonomous chapters across the Alps that meet annually at the Motherhouse in Bavaria.

name: Motherhouse of the Covenant of the Icy North
description: The Bavarian seat of the Covenant of the Icy North, effectively a Guernicus house covenant of Quaesitores who manage the Bavarian Common and host the Tribunal and the Midsummer Fair.

name: Highest Aspiration
description: A covenant that previously held the Motherhouse site and was destroyed in the Sundering of Tremere, leaving its resources unclaimed.

name: Bavarian Common
description: The collective vis sources of the fallen covenant Highest Aspiration, harvested under Quaesitor oversight and divided annually among Alpine covenants.

name: Midsummer Fair
description: Annual gathering held at the Motherhouse of the Covenant of the Icy North where Alpine magi trade and socialize, coinciding with informal and Quaesitorial tribunals.

name: Magvillus
description: The domus magna of House Guernicus, an ally of the Motherhouse linked to it by Hermes Portal, where Quaesitores are retrained.

name: Rorschach Chapter
description: A tiny chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North near Rorschach, home to two Mercere magi and linked by Hermes Portal to the Motherhouse.

name: Juno's Spire
description: Chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North serving as the personal demesne of Archmagus Pietro, linked to the Motherhouse by a defended Hermes Portal.

name: Tower of Ashes
description: Chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North that is home to Archmaga Jacinta filia Nicoli of the line of Apromor.

name: Covenant Where Journeys End
description: Merinita and Bjornaer covenant in a frigid faerie regio on Mont Joux, founded 817, known for kidnapping travelers and its ice-distorted covenfolk.

name: Sinews of Knowledge
description: Pre-Hermetic covenant in caves behind a waterfall in the Bavarian Alps, home of the Longevity Project and famous as the home of the finest longevity potion maker.

name: Tarragon Vale
description: Unterwalden covenant of metaphysical geographers whose four magi and covenfolk vanished twenty-two years ago; its vis income is held by the Quaesitores.

name: Valnastium
description: Domus magna of House Jerbiton, a Roman villa in a hidden Dolomiti valley, founded 773, with chapters in several cities linked by Hermes Portals.

name: Rorschach
description: A village and center of trade on Lake Constance, near which lies the Mercere chapter house of the Covenant of the Icy North.

name: Lake Constance
description: Lake on which the trade village of Rorschach stands.

name: Saint Gallen
description: Place whose abbots own a palace near Rorschach; Valnastium has a chapter there and the abbot is an ally of Valnastium.

name: Mont Joux
description: The tallest summit in Europe, called Mons Iovis by the Romans after Jupiter Pennius; site of the Covenant Where Journeys End (later known as Mont Blanc).

name: Mont Maudit
description: The 'Accursed Mountain', second-highest peak of the Mont Joux ridge, where Bernard of Menthon chained or destroyed the demon worshipped as Jupiter.

name: Temple of Jupiter
description: Ruined temple at Montjoux, repeatedly ransacked during the barbarian invasions, which the maga Lucia sought.

name: Bright Winter
description: Faerie domain linked to the vast regio at Montjoux once ruled by the White Lady.

name: Arcadia
description: The faerie otherworld; an entrance to it lies on the peak above Journeys End, and Tarragon Vale's magi were pioneers there.

name: Land of Spirits
description: Mystical realm explored by the magi of Tarragon Vale alongside Arcadia.

name: Dachstein
description: Mountain home of the Frost Giants, allies of the Covenant Where Journeys End.

name: Righi
description: Alpine mountain where the magi of Journeys End wish to see giants return.

name: Bavarian Alps
description: Region where the Motherhouse and Sinews of Knowledge lie, and where five chapter houses were created after the fall of Highest Aspiration.

name: Alps
description: The mountain region that forms the Greater Alps Tribunal, where basilisks are unusually common.

name: Danube
description: River on a minor tributary of which Sinews of Knowledge lies.

name: Unterwalden
description: Region where Tarragon Vale is perched on a misty hilltop.

name: Dolomiti
description: Region in whose inaccessible valleys lies Jerbiton's family villa, now Valnastium.

name: Vienna
description: City where Valnastium keeps a chapter; basilisks are common near it.

name: Constance
description: City where Valnastium maintains a chapter.

name: Geneva
description: City where Valnastium has a small chapter.

name: Basel
description: City near which basilisks are relatively common.

name: Sicily
description: Site of a magical accident that led to the birth of two dozen Gifted children five years ago.

name: Verdi
description: Place where House Verditius holds its magic item competition.

name: Levant
description: Remote region from which magi dig up odd magic items that Balbina repairs.

name: Temple of Nodens
description: Temple in the Stonehenge Tribunal near which Cara was born, bearing rough drawings of piests.

name: Axis Magica
description: The site at the Cave of Twisting Shadows to which the ritually murdered Criamon Primi are bound as genii loci.

name: Tower of Skulls
description: The fate of solitary magi who slide into horrific Corpus craft, which Ragoneda fears.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: The Alpine Tribunal of the Order, where the Covenant of the Icy North and other covenants discussed lie.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal in which Athena Alpina was trained.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Neighboring Tribunal whose magi raid Alpine vis sites and try to poach from the Bavarian Common.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal whose magi try to poach from the Bavarian Common.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing the Temple of Nodens, near which Cara was born.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Frontier Tribunal to which young Alpine magi usually must emigrate for thirty years.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Frontier Tribunal to which young Alpine magi may emigrate; Kentigern's beast-mage tradition comes from Hibernia.

name: House Criamon
description: House whose Founder Criamon brought Twilight into Hermetic magic; its magi pursue the Enigma and their Primi dwell as ghosts at the Cave of Twisting Shadows.

name: House Bjornaer
description: House of shapeshifting magi with heartbeasts, which does not require its members to be proficient spellcasters.

name: House Guernicus
description: House of the Quaesitores, which effectively holds the Motherhouse of the Icy North and has Magvillus as its seat.

name: House Tytalus
description: House devoted to struggle; Pietro was trained in it and Adrasteia, Sabastien and Ragoneda belong to it.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: House of hedge traditions to which Kentigern belongs.

name: House Mercere
description: House of redcaps; two Mercere magi live at the Rorschach Chapter and supply redcaps with devices and longevity potions.

name: House Flambeau
description: House of fire magi; Pietro joined it by defeating its champions, and Jacinta may become its Prima.

name: House Merinita
description: House of faerie magi that dominates the Covenant Where Journeys End and opposed Tarragon Vale's ideology.

name: House Jerbiton
description: House devoted to culture and art, whose domus magna is Valnastium.

name: House Bonisagus
description: House of researchers; Philomena and Hubert pursue longevity research in it.

name: House Verditius
description: House of item-makers that holds a magic item competition at Verdi; a lineage of it works on hydraulics at Sinews of Knowledge.

name: House Diedne
description: Former House whose members carried a forked stick called a cymar; anti-Druidical prejudice persists.

name: House Tremere
description: House whose members are viewed with suspicion in the Alps; the Sundering of Tremere destroyed Highest Aspiration.

name: Jane, the Fifth Primus
description: Ghost of the fifth Primus of House Criamon at the Cave of Twisting Shadows, the youngest Primus who knew Criamon in life; friendly and willing to tutor outsiders.

name: Criamon
description: Founder of House Criamon, a scion of Empedocles' lineage, through whom Twilight entered Hermetic magic; he is unable to enter Twilight himself.

name: Empedocles
description: Ancient Greek mystic who opened a path to Twilight by casting himself into a volcano; Criamon descended from his lineage.

name: Athena Alpina
description: Guernicus Intéllego specialist and chief Quaesitor of the Alps, who coordinates the Midsummer Fair and favors a greater role for the Tremere.

name: Mircalla
description: Ghost of the Motherhouse, a mother murdered by a magus's grogs, immune to Hermetic magic and protective of mistreated apprentices.

name: Cato
description: Guernicus Quaesitor, second-most senior in the Tribunal, who spies disguised as a mundane using subtle illusions.

name: Adrasteia of Tytalus
description: Quaesitor who roves the Tribunal borders laying traps for vis raiders, often with hoplites.

name: Kentigern of Ex Miscellanea
description: Quaesitor from a Hibernian beast-mage tradition with an affinity for dogs, controlling a pack of faerie hounds.

name: Tobias
description: Kentigern's familiar, a faerie hound that leads his pack and can cast Soothe the Pains of the Beast.

name: Vincent
description: Archmage follower of Criamon who seeks the Enigma through violent magic and is a fine certámen practitioner.

name: Katrina of Bjornaer
description: One of the Order's youngest hoplites, whose heartbeast is a wolverine; she serves the Quaesitores and allies with Adrasteia.

name: Mary
description: Senior Mercere maga at the Rorschach Chapter who creates lesser enchanted devices of illusion and travel for redcaps.

name: Rogitien
description: Mercere alchemist at the Rorschach Chapter who brews longevity potions for redcaps and hoplites; he has the Gentle Gift.

name: Pietro
description: Archmagus and most senior hoplite of the Tribunal, originally Tytalus, who won entry to House Flambeau with lightning and founded the Pietrine lineage; rumored to be the Antares.

name: Cinnamon
description: Pietro's leopard familiar, which ambushes birds from behind cloudbanks.

name: Pralix
description: Great general in Order history sent against Dav'nalleous, said to have worn the Antares ruby.

name: Dav'nalleous
description: Foe against whom Pralix was sent.

name: Entisimon
description: General who marshaled the Flambeau during the Schism War and reputedly wore the Antares ruby.

name: Jacinta filia Nicoli
description: Archmaga of the line of Apromor, follower of Flambeau, the most competent Perdo magus in the Order and leader of the Rowan Sisterhood.

name: Apromor
description: Flambeau magus whose line of Perdo specialists includes Jacinta.

name: Lucia
description: Early Merinita maga and combat specialist who killed the White Lady and claimed the Montjoux regio.

name: White Lady
description: Faerie queen skilled in illusion who ruled the Montjoux regio linked to Bright Winter until slain by Lucia.

name: Bernard of Menthon
description: Blessed founder of the Alpine hospices who chained or destroyed the 'demon' worshipped as Jupiter on Mont Maudit.

name: Yselt filia Rosalia
description: Ice-distorted, faerie-blooded senior Merinita maga who leads the Covenant Where Journeys End and holds a veto; her sigil is the icicle.

name: Carlo filius Innocu
description: Merinita magus of Journeys End born of ice-distorted parents, with barbegazi features and powers.

name: Charlotte filia Lupina
description: Timid Merinita maga, daughter of a goose maiden, with latent skinchanging ability.

name: Giselle filia Bertrand
description: Merinita maga whose father was a water elemental; practical, skilled in certámen, and often represents her covenant.

name: Capra filia Bullfinch
description: Bjornaer maga with an ibex heartbeast, a faerie midwife who believes she is destined to raise the new Jupiter Pennius.

name: Miklos filius Kosma
description: Faerie-blooded young Jerbiton magus at Journeys End, a musician and enchanted tailor married to Lyndsay.

name: Lyndsay
description: Chief equerry of the Covenant Where Journeys End and Miklos's true love.

name: Eginhard filius Caspar
description: Bjornaer magus with a lammergeir heartbeast, pair-bonded to Kamilla; glacially patient schemer.

name: Kamillia filia Bamber
description: Bjornaer maga with a lammergeir heartbeast, the dominant partner of the pair-bonded couple with Eginhard.

name: Jupiter Pennius
description: Celtic deity of Alpine storms after whom Mont Joux was named; the magi think he was a powerful faerie whose death closed the regio.

name: Sabrina filia Maura
description: Maga who first improved Bonisagus's longevity potions and became third Primus of House Bonisagus.

name: Sancia filia Sabrina
description: Perdo Corpus archmage awarded the Sinews site at the Grand Tribunal of 865, who founded the Longevity Project.

name: Guernicus
description: Founder of House Guernicus, who determined the 'dead god' skeleton was a magical creature outside the Code.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder of House Bonisagus, creator of the first longevity potions; a chair at Valnastium is kept in his honor.

name: Philomena filia Rafe
description: Archmaga of Bonisagus and chief researcher of the Longevity Project, a Progressive and secret Amaranth halfling.

name: Paxon filius Valentin
description: Archmage of Verditius, the finest brewer of longevity potions in the Order, based at Sinews of Knowledge.

name: Hubert filius Lorenz
description: Bonisagus magus researching hedge-magic longevity methods, such as inverting the familiar bond.

name: Balbina filia Havelock
description: Verditius maga with a stammering curse who repairs enchanted items and maintains Sinews' devices.

name: Himinis the Mad
description: Balbina's ancestor, whose magic items contain dangerous humorous effects.

name: Sabastien filius Luise
description: Tytalus 'professional intruder' who disarms wards in dead magi's sancta and has one of the highest Parma Magica scores in the Order.

name: Cara filia Sigurd
description: Bjornaer maga with a piest heartbeast who farms shellfish and lobsters in the lake beneath Sinews of Knowledge.

name: Ragoneda filia Elisa
description: Young Tytalus Corpus specialist and bone maga, a long-term visitor and negotiator for Sinews of Knowledge.

name: Augustina
description: Ragoneda's apprentice of eight years, a bone maga working in Animál who seeks adventure.

name: Cymena the Redcap
description: Nonmagical redcap living at Tarragon Vale, whose grandparents were from there; carries a lickstone and wears dragonette-skin boots.

name: Jerbiton
description: Founder of House Jerbiton, descended from a Roman soldier; he hid his family's valley villa, which became Valnastium.

name: Andru filius Astrolabe
description: Primus of House Jerbiton since 1182, a Greek-born illusionist who seeks to reconcile the Church and the Order; married to Carmine.

name: Constance filia Vortimer
description: Secundus of House Jerbiton, a core member of Valnastium.

name: Sourdine filia Bronwyn
description: Jerbiton maga at Valnastium, Miklos's contact in smoothing disputes between Yselt and Andru.

name: Sirocco filia Andru
description: Jerbiton maga, core member of Valnastium.

name: Grazia filia Natura
description: Jerbiton maga, core member of Valnastium.

name: Kalliope filia Bibliophilus
description: Jerbiton maga, core member of Valnastium.

name: Bronwyn filia Astrolabe
description: Jerbiton maga, core member of Valnastium.

name: Josephine filia Theodore
description: Lartan Jerbiton maga at Valnastium.

name: Francois filius Alban
description: Lartan Jerbiton magus at Valnastium.

name: Chloe filia Andru
description: Lartan Jerbiton maga at Valnastium.

name: Carmine
description: Flambeau maga, long-term non-member at Valnastium, secretly married to Andru; keeps his sigil ring while he keeps her Veil of Fire.

name: Cyrian
description: Blessed figure whose fingerbone relic Andru carries.

name: Crucifixio
description: Andru's cat familiar with Magic Might 10.

name: Amalthea
description: Mythic goat that suckled Zeus; Capra sees herself as the new Amalthea.

name: Criamon Primi
description: The ghosts of the Primi of House Criamon, ritually bound as genii loci to the Axis Magica, who habitually predict the doom and rebirth of the Order.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organization of Hermetic magi, whose doom and rebirth the Criamon Primi predict.

name: Quaesitores
description: Guernicus investigators of Hermetic law who manage the Bavarian Common and hold Tarragon Vale's vis.

name: Pietrine lineage
description: Flambeau lineage founded by Pietro specializing in Auram lightning magic; its members call themselves Jovians.

name: Rowan Sisterhood
description: Informal group led by Jacinta, founded during the purge of the Shadow Flambeau, watching for diabolic or vampiric corruption.

name: Shadow Flambeau
description: Group purged within House Flambeau, during which the Rowan Sisterhood was founded.

name: Council of Archmagi
description: Council that reputedly appoints the Antares and hires Sabastien.

name: Frost Giants of Dachstein
description: Giants allied to the Covenant Where Journeys End.

name: Progressives
description: Highly skilled Bonisagus magi who view the Founder as fallible and do not see themselves as inferior to his generation.

name: Seekers
description: Hermetic tradition intensely interested in Sinews of Knowledge's 'dead god' vis source.

name: Longevity Project
description: Research project at Sinews of Knowledge founded by Sancia filia Sabrina to improve longevity potions, now led by Philomena.

name: Larta
description: Lineage of Jerbiton magi, three of whom are members of Valnastium.

name: The Fanes
description: Enemies of Valnastium, fought in a battle where the Standard of the Shadowy Men was used.

name: Mercurial priesthood
description: Ancient priesthood of Mercurian magic whose artifacts Sabastien is rumored to own.

name: Urbastis cult
description: Cult known to Andru's cat familiar through Legend Lore.

name: College of Cardinals
description: Body that elects the Pope, whose election practice House Jerbiton follows.

name: Hereditary priesthood of the dead god
description: Pre-Hermetic priests who guarded the 'dead god' skeleton at Sinews of Knowledge and were exterminated during the Sundering.

name: Hoplite
description: Hermetic enforcers serving the Quaesitores; Pietro is the Tribunal's most senior.

name: Redcap
description: Messengers of House Mercere, some nonmagical, who travel between covenants.

name: Primus
description: Head of a Hermetic House, elected in House Jerbiton by weighted votes.

name: Secundus
description: Deputy Primus of House Jerbiton; the Greater Secundus is the Primus's elected heir.

name: Antares
description: Rumored supreme war leader appointed by the Council of Archmagi, named for a great ruby badge of office.

name: Archmage
description: Magus of high rank; Katrina prepares to challenge for Archmagehood.

name: Halfling
description: Person with one faerie and one mortal parent, common among Journeys End Merinita.

name: Grog
description: Covenant soldiers and servants.

name: Hedge magician
description: Non-Hermetic magician, some of whom prolong their lives by magic.

name: Apprentice
description: Trainee magus; Mircalla protects mistreated apprentices.

name: Covenfolk
description: Mundane inhabitants of a covenant, often distorted by its aura.

name: Ghost
description: Spirit of the dead; wizard-ghosts have Magic Might of Creo+Vim+10 and a Desires Rest trait.

name: Genius Loci
description: Spirit of place that cannot be destroyed without destroying the aura it is bound to; the Criamon Primi are genii loci.

name: Basilisk
description: Dangerous beast hatched from an egg laid in a dung heap, relatively common in the Alps.

name: Iaculus
description: Winged snakes, called syrenii by Herodotus, considered ill-omened by Hermetic magi.

name: Faerie hound
description: Faerie dogs; Kentigern controls a pack and his familiar Tobias is one.

name: Barbegazi
description: Gnomes that served the White Lady, with huge feet and icicles in their beards.

name: Air elemental
description: Elemental spirit that Kentigern hunts through the sky.

name: Water elemental
description: Elemental; Giselle's father was one possessing a drowned sailor.

name: Piest
description: Irish serpent-whale that is Cara's heartbeast.

name: Lammergeir
description: Bearded vulture, the heartbeast of Eginhard and Kamilla.

name: Alpine dragonette
description: Small dragon of the Alps whose skin Cymena made into boots.

name: Goose maiden
description: Faerie shapeshifter; Charlotte's mother was one.

name: Dead god
description: Eight-foot magical skeleton shackled beneath Sinews of Knowledge whose regrowing flesh slows aging.

name: Giant
description: Beings the magi of Journeys End wish to see return to the Righi.

name: Animals of Virtue
description: Magical animals such as snakes and eagles with mystical methods of rejuvenation.

name: Hermes Portal
description: Enchanted gateway linking covenants and chapter houses, such as the Motherhouse, Rorschach and Valnastium.

name: Quaesitorial blindfold
description: Enchanted blindfold that aids detection of deception and clear reasoning.

name: Longevity potion
description: Magical potion that slows aging; Paxon is its finest brewer.

name: Narrative Map
description: Tarragon Vale's device displaying the underlying structures of mystical realms.

name: Miklos's mandolin
description: Magical mandolin won in Arcadia that commands living things through song lyrics.

name: Standard of the Shadowy Men
description: Jerbiton item creating Group Seven League Stride, invisibility and grog enhancements, used against the Fanes.

name: Veil of Fire
description: Carmine's sigil, an orange-red bridal veil embroidered with the hourglass of Flambeau, kept by Andru.

name: Fingerbone of Cyrian
description: Relic of Cyrian sewn into white silk, carried by Andru.

name: Lickstone
description: Small metal plate attached to the palate carrying redcap spells; Cymena's contains Seven-League Stride.

name: Antares ruby
description: Enormous ruby reputedly granting extraordinary powers, the badge of the Antares.

name: Crystals of Montjoux
description: Quartz and fluorite crystals found embedded together at Montjoux, with magical form and effect bonuses.

name: Cymar
description: Forked stick resembling a distaff carried by each member of House Diedne.

name: Spindle
description: Implement female magi carry to disguise magic items; has form and effect bonuses.

name: Distaff
description: Implement whose enchantment is rare due to anti-Druidic prejudice.

name: Virtuous Amaranth
description: Forbidden plant grown by mysterious faeries, addictive; Philomena's body produces it.

name: Favor
description: Class of objects arising from True Love sigils with properties transcending Hermetic limits.

name: Talisman
description: Magus's personal enchanted device; Ragoneda's is a bone spindle.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
description: Spell Hermetic magi cast on their dead to prevent ghosts; it does not affect the Criamon Primi, who are genii loci.

name: The Gift of the Enigma
description: Spell of which Archmage Vincent uses a deadly high-level optimization.

name: Soothe the Pains of the Beast
description: CrAn healing spell for animals known by Kentigern and cast by his familiar Tobias.

name: Call the Basilisk
description: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 50 spell that creates a basilisk so he can study them safely.

name: The Foes of the Ibis
description: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 40 spell creating a small flock of iaculii, winged snakes.

name: Daughter of Zephyrs
description: Kentigern's CrAn(Re) 45 spell creating a magical horse that gallops through the air.

name: Vision of the Marauding Beast
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: To Know the Owner as Might His Hound
description: InAn 25 spell letting Kentigern sense what an animal senses.

name: Opening the Tome of the Animal's Mind
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Mastering the Unruly Beast
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Commanding the Harnessed Beast
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Ward Against the Beasts of Legend
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: True Sight of the Air
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Chirurgeon's Healing Touch
description: CrCo 20 healing spell known by Kentigern, Miklos, Ragoneda and Andru.

name: The Inexorable Search
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Converse with Plant and Tree
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Eyes of the Past
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Perception of the Conflicting Motives
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Liar's Chime
description: InMe(Im) 25 modification of Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie that sounds a bell when the target lies.

name: Frosty Breath of the Spoken Lie
description: Spell that makes a liar's breath frosty, on which Liar's Chime is based.

name: Peering Into the Mortal Mind
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: The Thief of Memory
description: PeMe 25 spell removing all memory of an individual, place or event; Quaesitores use it to tidy up after Hermetic criminals.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: ReMe 20 spell known by Kentigern and Andru; Miklos's mandolin produces a similar effect.

name: Scales of Magical Weight
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Sense the Nature of Vis
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Sense of Lingering Magic
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Incantation of Lightning
description: Auram spell every Pietrine lineage magus must know and master.

name: Wings of the Soaring Wind
description: Auram flight spell that Pietrine magi learn in a Sun-duration version.

name: Carve the Mystic Tower
description: Jacinta's Perdo spell that etches away surplus rock to leave a building.

name: The Finch Flourish
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Blizzard of Down
description: Miklos's CrAn 20 spell that blinds and buries a group in feathery down.

name: The Scold's Bridle
description: Miklos's CrAn 20 spell creating a gag that forces magi to cast silently.

name: Cocoon of the Mulberry Worm
description: Miklos's CrAn 30 spell wrapping a target in layers of silk.

name: Panic of the Elephant's Mouse
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: The Gentle Beast
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: The Couturier's Art
description: Miklos's spell creating a complete set of clothes with accessories.

name: The Ninth Stitch
description: Miklos's spell that magically repairs an item of clothing.

name: Aura of Ennobled Presence
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Disguise of the Transformed Image
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Thoughts Within Babble
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Posing the Silent Question
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Recreating the Inner Sea
description: Ragoneda's CrAq(Co) 25 spell creating a liquid in which severed human flesh stays alive.

name: Shower of Needles
description: Ragoneda's CrCo(Re) 20 spell showering a target with bone needles.

name: Tempest of Needles
description: Group version of Shower of Needles known by Ragoneda.

name: Eyes of the Owl
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Rack of Thorns
description: Ragoneda's MuCo 20 spell growing bone thorns inside the target's ribcage.

name: Preternatural Growth and Shrinking
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: Easing the Strain of Childbirth
description: Hermetic spell listed among the spells known by a magus in this text.

name: The Hidden Skin of the Serpent
description: MuCo 30 spell turning lower skin into osteoderm plates for +10 Soak.

name: The Suffering of the Seer
description: MuCo 35 spell sliding bone plates over the victim's eyes, blinding them.

name: Statue of Bone
description: Ragoneda's MuCo 50 spell calcifying an enemy into a statue of bone.

name: Shattered Leg
